label: Distinguish the principle of an operation from exercise through the form
summary: ST I q.76 a.1 supports the human soul as the principle of vital operations. That explanatory direction cannot establish an actual operation for every natural and intelligible form in the worklist signature. See docs/intellectual-appetite-source.md#intellectual-appetite-willing-and-self-operation-2026-11-26.
blocker: Restrict or calibrate FormIsPrincipleOfOperation to forms and operations that bear this exact relation.
